# EvolutionaryLearningYield

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A metric or objective function that quantifies the learning capability of a reservoir per unit of evolutionary effort, guiding the search for optimal network configurations. Provides a principled way to compare and select reservoir designs in neuromorphic systems, balancing learning accuracy with evolutionary cost.
